item.title: Cybersecurity experts urges stronger ‘cyber hygiene’ after Cape Fear scams

item.title: Former President Barack Obama speaks out on ICE shootings in Minnesota: “This is not the America we believe in”
item.description: Former President Barack Obama spoke out in a recent interview on the recent Immigration and Customs Enforcement shootings in Minnesota that took the lives of Renee Good and Alex Pretti and addressed the state of the country.
